name: Private Click Measurement (Safari to app)
plain: Safari can report that an ad click on a web page led to an app install or purchase, without IDs.
meaning: Lets a publisher site and an app measure click-to-install conversions through Apple's own delays and limited data bits.

android.note: Chrome Attribution Reporting for Android web-to-app is retired with the rest of Privacy Sandbox.

ios.api_surface: HTML attributionsourceid, attributiondestination; SKAdNetwork/AdAttributionKit for app conversion
ios.note: Click side: ad link on a web page. App side: conversion value update through SKAN or AdAttributionKit.

limits.headline: Can tell a site an ad click led to an install, without a device ID
limits.user_action: You tap an ad in Safari, then install or buy in the app
can: Report that a click led to an install or purchase
Send a few small bits of data after a delay
Use Apple's delayed reports to carry the result
cannot: Name you or give your device ID
Send exact timing; Apple adds delays and limits the data
Work on Android; Chrome's version was retired
limits.differs: iPhone only (iOS 14.5 and later). Chrome's Android version was retired.

story.what_it_is: Safari can report that an ad click on a website led to an app install or purchase, without IDs.

marketing.name: Private Click Measurement
marketing.pitch: Measure ad conversions from the web without tracking people across sites.

story.for_you: You tap an ad on a web page, install the app and buy. Safari quietly tells the publisher and the app maker that the ad worked, but not who you are.
story.for_makers: It lets a site and an app measure clicks to installs using only a few bits of data and a built in delay. Makers get honest counts while Apple holds the line on privacy.

use_cases.example: A news site runs an ad for a game and gets a count of installs after the click.
A game maker learns that a web ad led to a first purchase, with no user ID.
A retailer sees how many Safari clicks became app orders.
An ad network reports a weekly total of conversions with random delays.
A growth team compares PCM counts with SKAN counts to cross check them.
Delays and noise prevent anyone from tracing a click to a person.

story.android_note: Android's matching plan was the Attribution Reporting API, which Google is retiring.
story.ios_note: Works in Safari and in apps that use SKAdNetwork.

history.change: PCM shipped in Safari and WebKit
